茂密的热带森林

en: growing thickly and strongly in a way that is attractive
ex: luxuriant vegetation
茂密的草木

en: in a way that is thick and attractive
ex: a tall, luxuriantly bearded man
留有浓密胡须的高个子男人

en: to relax while enjoying something very pleasant
ex: She luxuriated in all the attention she received.
她既备受关注，一路陶醉其中。

豪华旅馆

in a way that shows physical comfort or pleasure
en: in a way that is very comfortable and full of expensive things that give pleasure
ex: luxuriously comfortable
豪华舒适

zh: 不常有的乐趣（或享受、优势）

过分奢侈的生活

en: long wave

长波 1 500 米
